findings.highlight: I should go and explain to Sakura now.
findings.evidenceJa: 早いうちに桜に説明しておくべき
findings.governingReading: Shirou decides he should explain matters to Sakura before long.
findings.explanation: Now changes a general early priority into an immediate fixed action.

findings.highlight: I arrive at the fourth floor, the first year hallway.
findings.evidenceJa: 四階、一年生の教室にやってくる
findings.governingReading: Shirou comes to the first-year classroom on the fourth floor.
findings.explanation: The destination changes from Sakura’s classroom to a hallway.

findings.highlight: she seems okay.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は思ったより元気そうだ
findings.governingReading: Sakura looks more energetic than Shirou expected after the Shinji incident.
findings.explanation: Seems okay drops the comparison with his expectation and weakens her apparent condition.

findings.highlight: I want to apologize before I went home.
findings.evidenceJa: 帰る前に謝っておきたかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou wants to apologize before he goes home.
findings.explanation: Past went conflicts with the present conversation and future departure.

findings.highlight: EhSenpai?
findings.evidenceJa: え先輩
findings.governingReading: Sakura breaks into a startled address.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses Eh and Senpai.

findings.highlight: I won’t ask what kind of circumstances you’re in.
findings.evidenceJa: どんな事情があるのかも訊きません
findings.governingReading: Sakura will not ask what circumstances require Rin’s lodging.
findings.explanation: You’re in redirects the unknown circumstances toward Shirou personally.

findings.highlight: “T-Thank God I didn’t say that” And she lets out a sigh
findings.evidenceJa: い、言わなくて良かったぁ
findings.governingReading: Sakura sighs that she is glad she did not voice her objection, for reasons Shirou does not grasp.
findings.explanation: The quotation and following conjunction form a broken sentence.

findings.highlight: there’s something strange mixed into that expression
findings.evidenceJa: なんか、おかしなのが交ざっていた気がして
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes something anomalous was mixed into his list of students.
findings.explanation: Expression points to wording or a facial look rather than the comic enumeration.

findings.highlight: I’m caught, as I expected.
findings.evidenceJa: やっぱり捕まってしまった
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he has been caught figuratively, then explains he voluntarily stops because fleeing home would be worse.
findings.explanation: The English repeats literal capture language and underplays his choice to stop.

findings.highlight: she’s really pissed.
findings.evidenceJa: 怒っている怒っている
findings.governingReading: Shirou observes, with comic repetition, that Rin is indeed angry.
findings.explanation: Pissed adds coarse slang and removes the rhythmic repetition.

findings.highlight: Uhno, there’s no need for you to apologize
findings.evidenceJa: あいや、遠坂が謝るコトなんてない
findings.governingReading: Shirou stammers that Rin need not apologize.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses Uh and no.

findings.highlight: it will pretty much encircle the whole school
findings.evidenceJa: 学校の敷地をほぼ包み込む
findings.governingReading: Once active, the field covers almost the entire school grounds.
findings.explanation: Encircle can mean surrounding only the perimeter rather than encompassing the people inside.

findings.highlight: steals blood and meat
findings.evidenceJa: 血肉を奪うタイプ
findings.governingReading: The field strips blood and flesh from people inside.
findings.explanation: Meat is a crude culinary literalism for human flesh.

findings.highlight: I felt a bit strange
findings.evidenceJa: なんとも言えない違和感
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls an indefinable sense that something was wrong.
findings.explanation: Felt a bit strange relocates the disturbance into his mild personal state.

findings.highlight: Sothere’s a Master at this school
findings.evidenceJa: つまり学校に、マスターがいる
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes a Master is present at school.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses So and there’s.

findings.highlight: My relaxed feelings go tense. …No wonder Tohsaka got so angry.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が本気で怒るワケだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou understands why Rin was truly angry after he spent the day unaware.
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts the awareness-tightening line from the alternate branch before the active narration.

findings.highlight: “” My vision blurs for a bit.
findings.evidenceJa: な
findings.governingReading: Shirou emits a stunned, incomplete sound before his vision distorts.
findings.explanation: The vocal reaction is replaced by an empty quotation.

findings.highlight: Trying to comprehend what Tohsaka is saying
findings.evidenceJa: 出来るだけ明確にイメージしようとして
findings.governingReading: Shirou tries to visualize Rin’s warning as clearly as possible.
findings.explanation: Comprehend removes his deliberate construction of the worst image.

findings.highlight: I found all the sources for the boundary field
findings.evidenceJa: 結界の基点は全部捜した
findings.governingReading: Rin located every anchor point of the bounded field.
findings.explanation: Sources replaces the technical anchor points and conflicts with the singular source that follows.

findings.highlight: the boundary field will not be activated as long as you’re here?
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂がいるかぎりは結界は張られないのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks whether Rin prevents the field from being laid, and she corrects that it is already laid.
findings.explanation: The English silently repairs his confusion and erases the setup-versus-activation distinction.

findings.highlight: that’s only optimism
findings.evidenceJa: それも都合のいい願いでしょうね
findings.governingReading: Rin calls that a self-serving, convenient hope.
findings.explanation: Optimism removes the criticism that the belief merely suits their wishes.

findings.highlight: The boundary field will be activated even if he does nothing
findings.evidenceJa: あとは黙ってても結界は発動するんだから
findings.governingReading: The prepared enemy can remain hidden and wait until choosing activation.
findings.explanation: The English asserts automatic activation, contradicting the Master-or-Servant trigger condition on page54.

findings.highlight: I can’t forgive a guy who would set up such a field
findings.evidenceJa: 野放しにしておけない
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes someone who made the field cannot be left at large.
findings.explanation: Cannot forgive turns a practical duty to stop the threat into a personal moral refusal.

findings.highlight: Geez…
findings.evidenceJa: む
findings.governingReading: Shirou gives a brief thoughtful or reluctant grunt.
findings.explanation: Geez adds irritation toward Rin’s reminder.

findings.highlight: go home before the sun goes down
findings.evidenceJa: 日が落ちるまでに家に帰る
findings.governingReading: Shirou was permitted to act alone on condition he return home by sunset.
findings.explanation: Before moves the deadline earlier than the inclusive by condition.

findings.highlight: leave the school building after that
findings.evidenceJa: 早足で校庭を後にした
findings.governingReading: Shirou quickly leaves the school grounds after watching Rin head behind the building.
findings.explanation: The English changes the exited space from grounds to building and omits his quick pace.
